title: GNOMON
title_controls: Move: {move}     Jump: Space     Dash: Shift or right click, hold to run
title_controls_2: Sun: {back} / {fwd} or wheel     Back to the platform: {reset}     Pause: Esc
tip_start: The sun obeys you: hold {back} to wind it back, {fwd} to move it forward.
tip_shadow: Only the black stones cast a shadow, and that shadow is solid. Wind the sun back towards dawn: the wall's shadow stretches all the way to the Dial.
tip_hub: The great gnomon awaits three seals: the circle of dawn, the square of noon and the triangle of dusk.
tip_dash: Shift or right click: a dash, on the ground or in the air. It recharges when you touch the ground, or when you take a shard.
tip_mantle: Jump at a ledge to climb onto it, even the edge of a hanging shadow.
tip_cloud: Under a cloud, no shadow holds. Cross between two clouds.
tip_ferry: The hanging block shuttles back and forth on its own, and its shadow is a ferry. The hour shifts its route.
tip_jib: The black jib turns and its shadow sweeps the void. Step on it as it passes: the hour moves the centre of its sweep.
tip_launch: A moving shadow carries you. Jump at the right moment: you keep its speed.
tip_fall: The void takes you back to the last platform. {reset} also takes you back, without a fall.
tip_beam: The seal is yours. The column of light takes you back to the Dial.
tip_final: The great gnomon stands. At noon, its shadow leads to the Oculus.
end_text: The three seals are set and the great dial tells the hours again.
end_hint: Click to go back to the title screen
